     1	package example
     2
     3	import (
     4		"fmt"
     5		"time"
     6	)
     7
     8	// Config holds configuration.
     9	type Config struct {
    10		Host    string
    11		Port    int
    12		Timeout time.Duration
    13	}
    14
    15	const (
    16		DefaultHost = "localhost"
    17		DefaultPort = 8080
    18	)
    19
    20	type Handler interface {
    21		Handle(c *Config) error
    22		Name() string
    23	}
    24
    25	// Run starts the service.
    26	func Run(c *Config) error {
    27		fmt.Printf("Starting on %s:%d\n", c.Host, c.Port)
    28		return nil
    29	}
    30
    31	// Stop stops the service.
    32	func Stop() {
    33		fmt.Println("Stopping")
    34	}
